summary: Two Hands Corporation filed an 8-K reporting a convertible note financing with Vanquish Funding Group LLC. The company issued a $151,800 convertible promissory note for net proceeds of $125,000, with a 10% interest rate and maturity on July 6, 2027. The note is convertible into common stock at 75% of the lowest closing bid price over the prior 10 trading days, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap. Prepayment is allowed at 125% within 180 days. This is a routine capital raising transaction, not a special situation.
